name: YJ Meta3 3x3 (Wing-Magnetic + 8-Magnet Ball-Core + UV)
description: The YJ Meta3 3x3 (Wing-Magnetic + 8-Magnet Ball-Core + UV) is the flagship version of the Meta3. This cube combines center-to-edge foot magnets with an 8-magnet ball-core for extra stability, control, and tactility. The UV coating adds a premium glossy finish that can aid grip and resist wear.
